## About
Built a **responsive lead-generation website** for Meiro Tigan, a concrete contractor in the Lower Mainland. The site is designed to drive quote requests and make service information easy to browse on mobile.

## Highlights
- **Lead generation:** built service pages and a quote/contact flow for inbound inquiries.
- **Responsive design:** optimized layouts for homeowners browsing on phones.
- **Business website:** translated a contractor service business into a cleaner digital acquisition surface.
- **Quick stack:** **React**, **responsive web**, **quote/contact flow**, **lead gen**.

## How it works
- Visitors land on service-oriented pages designed to explain offerings clearly and move them toward a quote request.
- The quote/contact flow captures lead information and routes inquiries to the business.
- The site is structured around mobile-first browsing patterns because many customers discover service businesses on their phones.
- The engineering focus is on clarity, conversion, and usable responsive layouts rather than heavy application logic.

## What I would do next
- Add more conversion analytics around service-page performance.
- Expand trust/portfolio sections with richer project examples and social proof.
- Test different quote-form entry patterns to improve completion rate.
